author: Felix
abstract: Organize messy video downloads into Infuse/Plex/VidHub-ready structure. Auto-detects 7 episode numbering formats (S01E01, 1x01, S01EP1, 101, 第1季第3集, 剧名01.mp4, etc.), verifies show names against TMDB, and sorts into canonical TV Shows/Show Name/Season XX/ layout. Supports dry-run preview, --names mapping, batch execution. 整理下载的视频文件，自动识别 7 种集号格式，对照 TMDB 确定正确剧名和季号。
